_comment: F38 tier-1 hero pieces (close-1024). Each group is OFF until judged on its stands; see meadows_hero_pieces.gd. World coordinates; y comes from the terrain minus sink_m.

cliffs._why: P2-014 at band2_stone_and_root_1 (GPU 5.82): 'replace the faceted cliff planes with dark slashes with sculpted, stratified rock'. The coordinator's Meshy cliff modules (tb/meshy-1024 4eb886a11, Veilfall/Aviary stratified cliff refs) flank the Burrow mouth (-357, 2610) along the bank face that the band2_stone_and_root_1 stands look at from the south-east: 30 m modules (about 15 m tall, roughly 8x the 1.80 m trainer) buried 3 m, the 12 m corner beyond. Yaw 135 faces the stands; placement verified by CPU capture before judging.

ironwood._why: band4 ironwood (GPU 6.29/6.12, not tier 1): 'replace the faceted, blobby canopies with real leaf-card canopies'. Two coordinator Meshy hero trees (about 14 m) beside the band4 ironwood stands. Not yet placed: positions follow the cliffs and gatehouse.
